versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- First public version of the skill for purchasing and applying SSL certificates via Alibaba Cloud CAS (China and International sites supported).
- Automates instance acquisition (purchase new or reuse inactive) and certificate application for DV/OV/EV certificates.
- Implements strict intent clarification, parameter confirmation, and confirmation gates to prevent accidental purchases or operations.
- Provides clear, documented flow for credential checks, permission handling, plugin requirements, and environment variable usage.
- Removes sample file: skill-card.md.

alibabacloud-cas-ssl-cert-purchase 0.0.1-beta.1 (Initial beta release)

- Automates the purchase and application of Alibaba Cloud SSL certificates (DV/OV/EV) for China and International regions.
- Supports user-initiated workflows: instance acquisition via API or reuse, and domain certificate application.
- Enforces strict intent clarification and permission checks before executing operations.
- Integration with BSS for purchasing; includes plugin and credential validations.
- Session-based observability and user-agent tagging for all operational API calls.
- Full user-driven parameter confirmation, with hard confirmation gates for cost-related actions.
